facts.fact: The article says Côte d'Ivoire is accelerating deployment of its national AI and data governance strategy, and the Ministry of Digital Transition opened a call on 26 May 2026 for six senior posts to strengthen delivery of state digital projects; it gives no adoption or launch date for the strategy.
facts.system: national strategy on artificial intelligence and data governance

note: The posts are ministerial advisers and directors, not a body tied to the data strategy, so no use fact.
